messages:
marta: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands. Recording + condensed Q&A + slides are here: https://redwood.company/ah/2026-03-22-recording and the short notes below. If you raised a question in the live thread I’ve tried to capture it and tag owners. Please add any corrections.
ajay: Quick Q — timeline for Dedicated in eu-west? We have a customer asking about regional SLAs.
marta: Short answer: target pilot in eu-west in Q3, GA in Q4, pending capacity and validation. Will confirm exact dates after infra validation in early May. @kevin to confirm infra plan.
sophie: Can we get a sample config for Private VPC onboarding? legal wants to see network controls before we promise a date.
marta: Good ask. @kevin — can you drop a sample topology + checklist (network, KMS, audit) into the private-deploy repo by EOD next Tue? Also add a one-pager for sales.
kevin: I can own that. I’ll create a draft checklist and a topo diagram. Putting a PR in next Monday.
daria: On the Optimize item — any reprioritization? We had a push for better batching heuristics in Q2.
marta: Optimize work (batching + cache) stays top-3 for infra/serving in Q2. We’ll publish the perf targets in the roadmap doc. Link: https://redwood.company/roadmap/q2-2026
sam: For customers asking about unit-cost examples, can we publish a sample cost table showing examples (chat vs embeddings) with recommended configs?
marta: Yes. Action: create 2 sample cost sheets (chat, embeddings) + recommended quantization/batch settings. Owner: @olivia. Due: two weeks.
olivia: I’ll put a template in the docs site and ping support for real-world numbers. Also will ask Solutions Eng for 3 customer examples.
deploy-bot: Recording uploaded: https://storage.redwood.company/ah/2026-03-22/recording.mp4 (size 420MB)
ajay: Thanks. One more: can leadership share the canary/fallback policy for model rollouts? We had some confusion during the demo.
marta: Canary policy is in the rollout playbook; quick TL;DR: 1) canary to 5% traffic -> 24h monitor -> ramp to 25% -> 72h monitor -> GA. Auto-fallback to previous variant on >1.5x error/latency baseline. I’ll paste the playbook link in a follow-up.
kevin: I’ll add the exact thresholds and the observability dashboard links to the playbook.
marta: Action items recap (add if missing):\n- Kevin: private deployment topology + checklist (due next Tue)\n- Olivia: sample cost sheets + 3 customer examples (due in 2 weeks)\n- Kevin: rollout playbook thresholds & dashboard links (due 1 week)\n- Product/Optimize: publish perf targets for batching/cache in roadmap doc (owner: @daria, due 2 weeks)\n- Marta: schedule a 30m deep-dive on routing/cost controls (will send invite)\nPlease comment if you want to claim or change owners.
sophie: One tiny clarification — are the SLA numbers for Dedicated the same as Hosted for latency? Sales is asking about per-region latency SLOs.
marta: Not identical; Dedicated will have tighter throughput guarantees but latency SLOs depend on config and hardware. We’ll publish a guidance matrix in the Dedicated docs.
olivia: I’ll include an FAQ entry for sales with that matrix and a contact for custom SLAs.
marta: Thanks all — I’ll follow up with the calendar invite and the playbook link. If you want to flag anything as high priority, reply here or DM me. :thumbsup:
